title: Larry Johnson: NATO Attacks Russia in the Baltic Sea
summary:
Larry Johnson is a former CIA intelligence analyst who also worked at the U.S. State Department's Office of Counterterrorism. Johnson discusses the attack on a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic Sea, and the air alarms going off in Kaliningrad. Read Larry Johnson's Sonar21: https://sonar21.com/
